resources.string: Tenshu Control is installed but isn't set up on this device yet. Calendar keeps your events in Control — open it to start fresh or join your other devices, then come back.
Tenshu Control isn't installed on this device. Calendar keeps your events through Control, so there's nothing to show until it's installed.
Tenshu Control isn't installed on this device, and it isn't in the store yet — your calendar stays empty until it is.
Tenshu Control isn't installed on this device. Install it the same way you installed Calendar.
Can't reach Tenshu Control — your events can't load. Make sure Control is installed and running.
Calendar is newer than Tenshu Control on this device. Update Control to keep your events syncing.
Tenshu Control is newer than Calendar on this device. Update Calendar to keep your events syncing.
Calendar and Tenshu Control disagree on a data version. Update both to keep your events syncing.
This device is behind the rest of your realm and has stopped receiving events. Update Tenshu Control to catch up.
This device is behind the rest of your realm and has stopped receiving events. Update Calendar to catch up.
This device is behind the rest of your realm and has stopped receiving events. Update Calendar and Tenshu Control to catch up.
This device is behind the rest of your realm and has stopped receiving events. Update Tenshu on this device to catch up.
